reunion.speaker: mira
reunion.text: *sets the fitting aside* You have the look of someone bringing me another job.

reunion.speaker: mira
reunion.text: Ah. I wondered when he’d ask me about that noise.

reunion.speaker: caelan
reunion.text: He came to the sanctuary himself.

reunion.speaker: caelan
reunion.text: He needs the flour ready for the Festival of Light. I think he’s already imagining everyone asking where their bread is.

reunion.speaker: mira
reunion.text: He’ll have plenty to say if they ask him at once.

reunion.speaker: caelan
reunion.text: He had plenty to say when it was only me.

reunion.speaker: mira
reunion.text: Of course. Let me leave this somewhere I can find it again.

reunion.speaker: mira
reunion.text: I’ve got my tools. I’ll bring the spear as well, in case we have to go upriver. Come on—we’ll see what the wheel’s doing before he takes anything apart.

mechanism.speaker: caelan
mechanism.text: *studies the axle* The axle’s still seated. I can’t see anything caught in the wheel.

mechanism.speaker: mira
mechanism.text: Neither can I. And nothing’s shifted out of place.

mechanism.speaker: mira
mechanism.text: Let’s give him a working mill before we tell him how pleased to be.

race.speaker: caelan
race.text: *frowns at the trickle* The brook’s moving, but there’s hardly anything coming down this channel.

race.speaker: mira
race.text: There should be a steady flow reaching the wheel.

race.speaker: caelan
race.text: Just a trickle. That won’t drive it.

race.speaker: mira
race.text: No. We’ll need to look further upstream.

diagnosis.speaker: mira
diagnosis.text: The wheel isn’t getting enough water to turn under load. Something’s restricting the intake.

diagnosis.speaker: mira
diagnosis.text: Could be. We’ll know when we see it.

diagnosis.speaker: mira
diagnosis.text: Back over the upper bridge, then north past the sanctuary steps. Take the road out of the village—the intake’s along that trail.

diagnosis.speaker: caelan
diagnosis.text: All right. Let’s see what’s caught there.

intake.speaker: caelan
intake.text: *points to the limb* There. That limb’s wedged across the screen.

intake.speaker: mira
intake.text: Look how the water’s pressing it into the bars.

intake.speaker: caelan
intake.text: We won’t pull it clear like that.

intake.speaker: mira
intake.text: No. We’ll take the pressure off first.

intake.speaker: mira
intake.text: Under the water in that little stone recess. We’ll deal with it once the intake’s isolated.

intake.speaker: caelan
intake.text: Tell me where you need me.

intake.speaker: mira
intake.text: I’ll set the bypass below the screen. Keep clear while I turn it.

prepare.speaker: mira
prepare.text: *checks Caelan is clear* That’s fine. Give me a moment.

prepare_done.speaker: mira
prepare_done.text: Good. We’ve still got water trapped around the catch, but the main flow’s off it now.

spell_intro.speaker: caelan
spell_intro.text: I could move that into the drain.

spell_intro.speaker: mira
spell_intro.text: Just the water in the recess?

spell_intro.speaker: caelan
spell_intro.text: Yes. There’s nowhere for more to come through now.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: It did. I can reach the catch now.

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: *a small smile* I thought it would.

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: *his smile fades a little* I couldn’t do it at the Venns’. I wanted to spare them the trouble, and I still ended up borrowing their tools.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: You were fighting a current there. This was a smaller job.

encouragement_failed.speaker: caelan
encouragement_failed.text: I know. I just wish I’d managed both.

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: You got their water running again, didn’t you?

encouragement_failed.speaker: mira
encouragement_failed.text: *gently* And you’ve cleared this catch for me. Give yourself that much.

encouragement.speaker: mira
encouragement.text: It did. I can reach the catch now.

encouragement.speaker: caelan
encouragement.text: You make it sound very impressive.

encouragement.speaker: mira
encouragement.text: I make it sound useful. I was going to have to scoop that out.

encouragement.speaker: caelan
encouragement.text: *laughs* Then I’m glad to have saved you the trouble.

repair.speaker: mira
repair.text: I’ll release the catch. Take the rope and keep it steady.

repair.speaker: mira
repair.text: Wait until I say. We want the limb clear of the screen.

repair_done.speaker: mira
repair_done.text: *with relief* There. Hold it a moment… Good. You can let go.

repair_done.speaker: mira
repair_done.text: It is. Let’s go back and see what the wheel makes of it.

verify.speaker: mira
verify.text: He’ll be calling it a lovely sound by now.

verify.speaker: caelan
verify.text: Should we let him enjoy it?

verify.speaker: mira
verify.text: After we tell him what happened. I want him to know which bits he doesn’t need to take apart.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: *listens to the wheel* There it is. I was beginning to miss that dreadful racket.

resolution.speaker: mira
resolution.text: A limb had jammed the intake screen. We freed it and reset the catch.

resolution.speaker: mira
resolution.text: Caelan cleared the water from the inspection recess. And did his share of the pulling.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: Mira knew what we were looking at.

resolution.speaker: mira
resolution.text: The wheel itself was sound. You can leave it together.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: Hmph. You can both laugh when the flour’s finished.

resolution.speaker: mira
resolution.text: How much have you got left?

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: Enough that I’d rather hear the wheel than the two of you. There are people waiting to start their festival baking.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: We’ll leave you to it, then.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: *more quietly* My thanks. To both of you.

resolution.speaker: halden
resolution.text: There’ll be flour for the Festival of Light. You can tell Serene that.

after.speaker: mira
after.text: *smiles* It hasn’t learned to finish itself.

halden_after.speaker: halden
halden_after.text: *with a satisfied grunt* Listen to that. I’ll take a working mill over a quiet one.

reminder.speaker: mira
reminder.text: We’ll work through it together. Show me what you’ve found.

halden_waiting.speaker: halden
halden_waiting.text: I’ll leave the checking to you and Mira. There’s plenty of festival flour still to grind.

reminder_diagnose.speaker: mira
reminder_diagnose.text: Let’s look at the wheel and the channel beside it. We’ll know more once we’ve checked both.

reminder_intake.speaker: mira
reminder_intake.text: We need the north road, past the sanctuary steps. The intake’s along the trail beyond the village.

reminder_prepare.speaker: mira
reminder_prepare.text: The bypass is below the screen. I’ll set it once you’re standing clear.

reminder_spell.speaker: mira
reminder_spell.text: The pressure’s off now. It’s just the water in that stone recess, with the drain beside it.

reminder_repair.speaker: mira
reminder_repair.text: We can reach the catch now. Take the rope by the lever when you’re ready, and I’ll release it.

reminder_verify.speaker: mira
reminder_verify.text: Let’s get back to the wheel and check it’s taking the load. Then we can give Halden some good news.

reminder_report.speaker: mira
reminder_report.text: Halden’s by the mill. Let’s tell him what we found before he starts taking anything apart.

warning.speaker: mira
warning.text: Before we go—stay close on the river path. Monsters come down to the water.

warning.speaker: mira
warning.text: *checks the spearhead* I’d rather have this with me.

warning.speaker: caelan
warning.text: I wasn’t planning to go farther than Halden’s yard today.

warning.speaker: mira
warning.text: Neither was I. Here—take the tool roll. We’ll keep to the open bank.

warning.speaker: caelan
warning.text: All right. North past the sanctuary steps, then.

encounter_intro.speaker: caelan
encounter_intro.text: *slows beside the torn bank* That tree’s come down across the water.

encounter_intro.speaker: mira
encounter_intro.text: And look at the bark. Those gouges are fresh.

encounter_intro.speaker: mira
encounter_intro.text: *her expression tightens* I see it. Stay with me.

encounter_intro.speaker: mira
encounter_intro.text: It must have. Look at its tusks. A broken limb from that tree would explain the intake.

encounter_intro.speaker: mira
encounter_intro.text: Easy, Caelan. Back slowly. Keep your feet under you.

encounter_intro.speaker: caelan
encounter_intro.text: *sets down the tool roll* I’m here.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: *steadies his breathing* You made that look easier than it felt.

aftermath.speaker: mira
aftermath.text: It wasn’t easy. Are you hurt?

aftermath.speaker: mira
aftermath.text: Let me look first. *checks his hands and shoulders*

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: I could barely get near it.

aftermath.speaker: mira
aftermath.text: I had the better reach. I was glad to have you beside me.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: Next time I’m bringing more than my hands.

aftermath.speaker: mira
aftermath.text: *a small, relieved laugh* A sound improvement.

aftermath.speaker: mira
aftermath.text: We’ll take the bank slowly. The intake’s just ahead.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: *picks up the tool roll* Let’s see if that’s where our limb ended up.

withdrawal.speaker: mira
withdrawal.text: We’re clear. Keep back from the bend for a moment.

withdrawal.speaker: caelan
withdrawal.text: It’s still between us and the intake.

withdrawal.speaker: mira
withdrawal.text: Yes. We’ll face it together when we go back up. Stay where I can see you.

retry.speaker: mira
retry.text: Keep your feet under you, Caelan. We’ll take the bend together.

retry.speaker: mira
retry.text: Watch for its head going down. Give yourself room to turn.

reminder_warning.speaker: mira
reminder_warning.text: Before we go—stay close on the river path. Monsters come down to the water.

reminder_warning.speaker: mira
reminder_warning.text: *checks the spearhead* I’d rather have this with me.

reminder_warning.speaker: caelan
reminder_warning.text: I wasn’t planning to go farther than Halden’s yard today.

reminder_warning.speaker: mira
reminder_warning.text: Neither was I. Here—take the tool roll. We’ll keep to the open bank.

reminder_warning.speaker: caelan
reminder_warning.text: All right. North past the sanctuary steps, then.

reminder_encounter.speaker: mira
reminder_encounter.text: The intake is beyond the bend in the north trail. Stay close—we’ll keep an eye on the riverbank together.

intake_combat.speaker: caelan
intake_combat.text: *points to the limb* There. That limb’s wedged across the screen.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: A fresh break, just like the tree by the path. That’s where it came from. Look how the water’s pressing it into the bars.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: *sets the spear safely beside the screen* Let me set this down. We’ll need the tools now.

intake_combat.speaker: caelan
intake_combat.text: We won’t pull it clear like that.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: No. We’ll take the pressure off first.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: Under the water in that little stone recess. We’ll deal with it once the intake’s isolated.

intake_combat.speaker: caelan
intake_combat.text: Tell me where you need me.

intake_combat.speaker: mira
intake_combat.text: I’ll set the bypass below the screen. Keep clear while I turn it.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: *listens to the wheel* There it is. I was beginning to miss that dreadful racket.

resolution_combat.speaker: caelan
resolution_combat.text: Mira said you would.

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: A limb had jammed the intake screen. We freed it and reset the catch.

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: There was a ridgeback tusker on the upper path. It must have brought the tree down.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: *his frown deepens* That close to the road?

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: It’s gone, but the bank’s torn up. Tell the carriers to keep back from the edge.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: I’ll pass the word before the next load goes up. And I’m glad you both came back.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: *raises an eyebrow* We?

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: Caelan cleared the water from the inspection recess. And did his share of the pulling.

resolution_combat.speaker: caelan
resolution_combat.text: Mira knew what we were looking at.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: And you listened. That helps.

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: The wheel itself was sound. You can leave it together.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: I hadn’t started.

resolution_combat.speaker: caelan
resolution_combat.text: We thought we’d best hurry.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: Hmph. You can both laugh when the flour’s finished.

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: How much have you got left?

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: Enough that I’d rather hear the wheel than the two of you. There are people waiting to start their festival baking.

resolution_combat.speaker: caelan
resolution_combat.text: We’ll leave you to it, then.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: Caelan.

resolution_combat.speaker: caelan
resolution_combat.text: Yes?

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: *more quietly* My thanks. To both of you.

resolution_combat.speaker: mira
resolution_combat.text: You’re welcome.

resolution_combat.speaker: halden
resolution_combat.text: There’ll be flour for the Festival of Light. You can tell Serene that.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
aftermath_recovered.text: *kneels beside him and secures a bandage over the scrape* Easy. I’ve got you.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
aftermath_recovered.text: I could barely get near it.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
aftermath_recovered.text: I had the better reach. Can you stand?

aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
aftermath_recovered.text: *gets a foot under him* I think so.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
aftermath_recovered.text: *helps him up and checks the bandage* Keep beside me. We’ll take the bank slowly.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
aftermath_recovered.text: Next time I’m bringing more than my hands.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: mira
aftermath_recovered.text: *breathes out a small, relieved laugh* A sound improvement.

aftermath_recovered.speaker: caelan
aftermath_recovered.text: *picks up the tool roll* Let’s see if that’s where our limb ended up.
